## Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Sub Categories
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100504

## Settings Documentation for Streaming Sub Categories
This document provides detailed descriptions of the settings available for configuring the streaming sub categories section on the platform. Each setting allows for customization to meet specific needs and preferences.
To edit these settings, navigate to:
In the Admin Sidebar Open Settings
Select Designs Settings
Open The Homepage Tab
Open The Module Select Content to Display
Select The Streaming Sub Categories Option
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145396093/original/Ara7N-bed2FssOI9VOA_CVl-9h74iDipow.png?1719345971 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145396782/original/V0SusAbOUQL9dqMyFxEL6Nk3Wb1Q-EXDmQ.png?1719346536 | alt: ]

## Visual Guide of the  Streaming Sub Categories
These are the available settings for the Streaming Sub Categories section:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145397044/original/btCIRGooKXL85vzOq-1Pc6eD7o78Zvhm3A.png?1719346751 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169040199/original/9wzA4k50mifYbZM8eFbUcrnc_0g4651A8Q.png?1760546609 | alt: ]

## 1. Sub Level Categories Title
The "Sub Level Categories Title" setting allows admins to set the title for the sub level categories section. You can enter the desired title in the provided input field.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145397367/original/dx-3dgU7X3A8hut5b0xUXOIYGY2DjB37hg.png?1719347000 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145397381/original/T0NceC5TdXdIAZrC3CmKY-QC4A3pgYqc6w.png?1719347008 | alt: ]

## 2. Title Color
This setting enables admins to customize the color of the title. You can choose a color using the color picker tool or by entering the color code directly.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145397473/original/3DrxB_2KUixiX12pugvGaKuIShF66e9HZg.png?1719347071 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145397489/original/jU_1n-RQkZE1uAas1ivAAMgOU3JoNXvEog.png?1719347102 | alt: ]

## 3. Display Options
The display options control how many sub level categories are shown and how many results per row. You can set the number of results to display and choose the layout for the results.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145397500/original/Tl_3GGKrtJ3iWFFIandjne78fKuhkKy-0w.png?1719347138 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145397489/original/jU_1n-RQkZE1uAas1ivAAMgOU3JoNXvEog.png?1719347102 | alt: ]

## 4. Enable Carousel Slider
The carousel slider option allows the sub level categories to be displayed in a sliding carousel format. This can be toggled on or off.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145397628/original/3idgQvHTnsyy4gYa_q7ipBm-BIuFJ1J4Ug.png?1719347244 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145397787/original/iNL0Y0LV2ZE4HPZaYtpgfii7ppyP2C-KaA.png?1719347319 | alt: ]

## 5. Hide On Mobile
This setting lets admins decide whether to hide the sub level categories on mobile devices. You can enable or disable this option as needed.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145397870/original/r9n3FdxTzGvFYULtM44UigIot_DvHoHnRA.png?1719347362 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145397918/original/51tNtt1GxeCwXcB5HFQjI1fd-Utk9mCkOw.png?1719347420 | alt: ]

## 6. Show "View All" Button
This option enables the display of a "View All" button for sub level categories, allowing users to view all available categories.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169039866/original/PI0mcgEM3qilJWTaFYO5NSiJQppXr5t7RQ.png?1760546343 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169039875/original/2JJKZMxVYJ5heJocb31dlf6C_5rWyfL1Hg.png?1760546366 | alt: ]

## 7. Sort Categories
Admins can sort the sub level categories by different criteria, such as name (A-Z or Z-A), order (ascending or descending), or ID (ascending or descending).
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169039923/original/WNvsmLm3EFxNQ1_ZKhRVwx708l6lxfulNw.png?1760546414 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169040010/original/6y-tZQrpSvSHiEHkvVCH34Hx8tVx-4lv9Q.png?1760546497 | alt: ]

## 8. Category Levels to Show
This setting determines which levels of categories to display, including sub-categories and sub-sub-categories.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145398185/original/TVfkpZoum67qXLt11Z7zmGrZ0JyJ3YKl-w.png?1719347576 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145398516/original/jdTT27BkStMXta0Sid1craJ8jS5i6rxrvw.png?1719347857 | alt: ]

## 9. Top Level Category
Admins can specify under which top-level category the sub level categories should be displayed. This helps organize the categories better.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145398475/original/cX2cEUd-CkP2_NSAcj5RsUxp_ZA3_Ea8rg.png?1719347783 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145398542/original/hGk0v8rhvd_O32UnTqjDNtFrcBUZK2ZEsQ.png?1719347869 | alt: ]

## 10. Only Show Sub-Categories with Photos
This setting allows admins to filter the display to only show sub-categories that have associated photos. This can be enabled or disabled based on your preference.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145398508/original/c4QRNOyEFhFbfB05saxEsnWOBeebZKO8gg.png?1719347841 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145398568/original/dJkdkcJ6p7Kb-3NQqfv_9YWS9NRNumgcFw.png?1719347874 | alt: ]
